newsitem.title: GUYANA: Guyana's leader slightly reshuffles cabinet.
newsitem.headline: Guyana's leader slightly reshuffles cabinet.

text.p: Guyana's President Cheddi Jagan slightly reshuffled his government on Thursday in the first cabinet changes since he took office four years ago.
Government sources said the changes, although minor, were meant to instill new blood in the former British colony's ruling alliance ahead of general elections due next year.
Two ministers changed portfolios, a statement from the presidential office said.

Local Government Minister Moses Nagamootoo was named information minister. He was replaced by former Public Works and Communications Minister Harrispersaud Nokta at the head of an enlarged Regional and Local Government ministry.

Nokta's job was given to businessman and newcomer Anthony Xavier, a member of the Georgetown City Council. Jagan also decided to bring in the cabinet Guyana's ambassador to Venezuela, Satyadeo Sawh, as junior minister in the Agriculture Ministry.
Jagan, a 78-year-old onetime Marxist, became president in October 1992 after his People's Progressive Party (PPP) won the country's first democratic elections in 28 years.
